## Load Qi's Seurat object and select one biological replicate

```{r Load Qi data}
# Load into a separate environment so an Rdata workspace cannot overwrite
# this report's params or intermediate objects.
input_env <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
load(params$path_rdata_in, envir = input_env)
if (!exists("stall_fin", envir = input_env, inherits = FALSE)) {
  stop("The input Rdata must contain the Seurat object 'stall_fin'.")
}
seurat_obj <- input_env$stall_fin
rm(input_env)
if (!inherits(seurat_obj, "Seurat")) stop("stall_fin is not a Seurat object.")
if (!all(c("orig.ident", "celltype2") %in% colnames(seurat_obj[[]]))) {
  stop("The Seurat metadata must contain orig.ident and celltype2.")
}
print(table(seurat_obj$orig.ident))
biorep_id <- as.character(params$biorep_id)
if (length(biorep_id) != 1L || is.na(biorep_id) || !nzchar(biorep_id)) {
  stop("Set params$biorep_id to one orig.ident value: 1-7, 3-7, or 4-7.")
}
replicate_cells <- rownames(seurat_obj[[]])[
  as.character(seurat_obj$orig.ident) == biorep_id &
    !is.na(seurat_obj$orig.ident)
]
if (!length(replicate_cells)) stop("No cells found for biorep_id: ", biorep_id)
seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = replicate_cells)

# Select a raw-count assay; do not use integrated expression by default.
assay <- params$assay
available_assays <- SeuratObject::Assays(seurat_obj)
if (is.null(assay) || !nzchar(as.character(assay))) {
  candidates <- intersect(c("RNA", "Spatial"), available_assays)
  if (!length(candidates)) {
    stop("Set params$assay to the raw-count assay. Available: ",
         paste(available_assays, collapse = ", "))
  }
  assay <- candidates[1L]
}
assay <- as.character(assay)
if (!assay %in% available_assays) stop("Missing assay: ", assay)
DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- assay
if (!setequal(Cells(seurat_obj), colnames(seurat_obj))) {
  stop("The chosen count assay must contain all cells in this replicate.")
}
if (inherits(seurat_obj[[assay]], "Assay5")) {
  count_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(seurat_obj[[assay]], search = "^counts($|\\.)")
  if (!length(count_layers)) stop("The selected assay has no counts layer.")
  if (!identical(count_layers, "counts")) {
    seurat_obj[[assay]] <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
      seurat_obj[[assay]], layers = "counts", new = "counts"
    )
  }
}
counts_check <- LayerData(seurat_obj, assay = assay, layer = "counts")
if (!all(Cells(seurat_obj) %in% colnames(counts_check)) ||
    !nrow(counts_check) || any(Matrix::colSums(counts_check) <= 0)) {
  stop("Raw counts are missing, incomplete, or contain zero-library cells.")
}
rm(counts_check)

# Keep the original CSV column schema, but give every biological replicate
# a distinct sample_id and individual_id.
get_param_or <- function(name, default) {
  value <- params[[name]]
  if (is.null(value) || !length(value) || all(is.na(value)) ||
      !nzchar(as.character(value)[1L])) return(default)
  as.character(value)[1L]
}
sample_metadata <- list(
  sample_id = paste(get_param_or("sample_id", "ptr_st_qi"), biorep_id, sep = "_"),
  individual_id = get_param_or(
    "individual_id",
    paste(get_param_or("sample_id", "ptr_st_qi"), biorep_id, sep = "_")
  ),
  condition = get_param_or("condition", "ptr_st_qi"),
  batch = get_param_or("batch", "unspecified")
)
output_dir <- file.path(params$path_outdir, biorep_id, params$metric)
output_stem <- paste(sample_metadata$sample_id, params$metric, sep = "-")
path_key_data <- get_param_or(
  "path_key_data", file.path(output_dir, paste0(output_stem, "-key_data.csv"))
)
path_key_summary <- get_param_or(
  "path_key_summary", file.path(output_dir, paste0(output_stem, "-key_summary.csv"))
)
path_image <- get_param_or(
  "path_image", file.path(output_dir, paste0(output_stem, ".rdata"))
)
message("Biorep: ", biorep_id, "; raw-count assay: ", assay)
stopifnot(
  params$metric %in% c("spearman", "pearson", "Jensen-Shannon"),
  params$n_bins >= 4, params$n_bins == as.integer(params$n_bins),
  params$n_permutation >= 1, params$n_permutation == as.integer(params$n_permutation),
  params$n_bootstrap >= 2, params$n_bootstrap == as.integer(params$n_bootstrap),
  params$n_parallel >= 1, is.finite(params$window_dtw), params$window_dtw >= 0,
  params$seed >= 0, params$seed < .Machine$integer.max - 1L
)
```

Configure for parallel processing

```{r Configure for parallel processing}
Sys.setenv(
  OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1",
  OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1",
  MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1",
  VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS = "1"
)
get_n_workers <- function(n_tasks, requested = params$n_parallel) {
  slurm_cpus <- suppressWarnings(
    as.integer(Sys.getenv("SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK", unset = NA_character_))
  )

  available <- if (is.na(slurm_cpus)) {
    detected <- parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE)
    if (is.na(detected)) 1L else max(1L, detected - 1L)
  } else {
    slurm_cpus
  }

  max(
    1L, 
    min(as.integer(requested), as.integer(n_tasks), available)
  )
}
make_parallel_progress <- function(n) {
  pb <- utils::txtProgressBar(
    min = 0,
    max = n,
    style = 3,
    file = stderr()
  )

  list(
    pb = pb,
    snow_options = list(
      progress = function(completed) {
        utils::setTxtProgressBar(
          pb,
          completed
        )
      },

      # Required for progress to update as individual tasks finish.
      preschedule = FALSE
    )
  )
}
```

Global variables

```{r define global variables}
fusiform_lineage <- c(
  "FIC",
  "XMC",
  "XPC"
)
ray_lineage <- c(
  "RIC_1",
  "RIC_2",
  "XRP_1",
  "XRP_2",
  "XRP_3"
)
cluster_levels <- c(fusiform_lineage, ray_lineage)
ordered_factor <- function(values) {
  factor(
    values,
    levels = c(
      intersect(cluster_levels, values %>% unique %>% sort), 
      setdiff(values %>% unique %>% sort, cluster_levels)
    )
  )
}
lineage_cell_types <- list(
  Lineage1 = fusiform_lineage,
  Lineage2 = ray_lineage
)
```

Helper functions

```{r Define helper functions}
logcpm <- function(x) {
  totals <- colSums(x)
  if (any(!is.finite(totals) | totals <= 0)) {
    stop("A pseudobulk has no expression among the selected genes.")
  }
  log2(1 + 1e6 * sweep(as.matrix(x), 2, totals, "/"))
}
calculate_js_similarity <- function(mat1, mat2) {
  out <- jsDist(cbind(mat1, mat2))[
      1:ncol(mat1),
      (ncol(mat1)+1):(ncol(mat1)+ncol(mat2))
  ]
  rownames(out) <- colnames(mat1)
  colnames(out) <- colnames(mat2)
  return(1 - out)
}
calculate_similarity <- function(mat1, mat2, metrics) {
  stopifnot(metrics %in% c("spearman", "pearson", "Jensen-Shannon"))
  if (metrics %in% c("spearman", "pearson")) {
    cor(
      x = logcpm(mat1),
      y = logcpm(mat2),
      method = metrics
    )
  } else if (metrics == "Jensen-Shannon") {
    calculate_js_similarity(
      as.matrix(mat1),
      as.matrix(mat2)
    )
  }
}
```

Pairwise transcriptomic similarity among discrete cell states

```{r Discrete stages hourlgass}
# Use temporary group IDs because Seurat may replace underscores in names.
state_ids <- setNames(sprintf("State%02d", seq_along(cluster_levels)), cluster_levels)
seurat_obj$state_group <- unname(state_ids[as.character(seurat_obj$cell_label)])
pb_discrete <- AggregateExpression(
  seurat_obj,
  assays = assay,
  features = VariableFeatures(seurat_obj),
  group.by = "state_group",
  verbose = FALSE
)[[assay]]
pb_discrete <- pb_discrete[, unname(state_ids), drop = FALSE]
colnames(pb_discrete) <- cluster_levels
similarity_discrete <- calculate_similarity(
  pb_discrete[, fusiform_lineage, drop = FALSE],
  pb_discrete[, ray_lineage, drop = FALSE],
  metrics = params$metric
)
p_similarity_discrete <- pheatmap(
  similarity_discrete,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  main = sprintf("Fusiform vs Ray lineage: %s\n(%s)", biorep_id, params$metric)
)
```

## Test hourglass along pseudotime

**The procedure:**

1.  Infer pseudotime along cell lineages using Slingshot based on PCA coordinates.

2.  Aggregate expression by pseudotime bins (by `n_bins`).

3.  Calculate pairwise similarity between bins across lineages (using `metric`).

4.  Align cell lineages by bins using a Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) algorithm. (using `window_size`)

5.  Calculate the `hourglass score` based on cell lineage alignment.

    Hourglass score is defined as follows:

    Let $S_i$ denote the transcriptomic similarity at aligned pseudotime position $i$, and let $\mathcal{E}$, $\mathcal{M}$, and $\mathcal{L}$ denote the sets of early-, middle-, and late-stage positions, respectively. Stage-specific mean similarities were calculated as

    $$
    E=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{E}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{E}}S_i,\qquad
    M=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{M}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{M}}S_i,\qquad
    L=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{L}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{L}}S_i.
    $$

    The hourglass score was then defined as

    $$
    H=\min\left\{M-E,\;M-L\right\}.
    $$

    A positive score requires the middle-stage similarity to exceed both the early- and late-stage similarities.

6.  Permutation for the null distribution of the hourglass score\

    (1) Shuffle ray pseudotimes within this biological replicate, keeping the fusiform query and XMC stages fixed\
    (2) Repeat Step 2-5\
    (3) Estimate permutation p-value

7.  Bootstrapping for the confidence interval of the hourglass score\

    (1) Re-sample cells with replacement\
    (2) Repeat Step 1-5\
    (3) Estimate bootstrap confidence interval

### 1. Pseudotime inference

Slingshot pseudotimes were inferred based on PCA coordinates

```{r Create SlingshotDataSet}
slingshot_manual <- function(
    seurat_obj,
    extend = "y",
    stretch = 2,
    maxit = 15
  ) {
  missing <- setdiff(cluster_levels, unique(as.character(seurat_obj$cell_label)))
  if (length(missing)) stop("Missing developmental states: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  lineages <- new("SlingshotDataSet")

  # add cell embedding
  lineages@reducedDim <- seurat_obj %>% 
    Embeddings(reduction = "pca") %>% 
    extract(1:dim(seurat_obj)[2], 1:10) %>%
    as.matrix
  
  # add cluster matrix
  clusters <- factor(as.character(seurat_obj$cell_label), levels = cluster_levels)
  names(clusters) <- Cells(seurat_obj)
  mtx_clus <- matrix(0, nrow=length(clusters), ncol=length(levels(clusters)))
  row.names(mtx_clus) <- names(clusters)
  colnames(mtx_clus) <- levels(clusters)
  for (i in seq(length(clusters))) {
    mtx_clus[names(clusters)[i], clusters[i]] <- 1
  }
  lineages@clusterLabels <- mtx_clus
  
  # add lineages
  lineages@lineages <- lineage_cell_types
  
  # add adjacency matrix
  mtx_adj <- matrix(0, nrow = length(levels(clusters)), ncol = length(levels(clusters)))
  row.names(mtx_adj) <- colnames(mtx_adj) <- levels(clusters)
  for (l_i in lineages@lineages) {
    for (c_i in seq(length(l_i) - 1)) {
      mtx_adj[l_i[c_i], l_i[c_i + 1]] <- 1
      mtx_adj[l_i[c_i + 1], l_i[c_i]] <- 1
    }
  }
  lineages@adjacency <- mtx_adj
  
  # fit curves
  curves <- getCurves(
    lineages,
    approx_points = 100,
    reassign = FALSE,
    shrink = FALSE,
    extend = extend,
    stretch = stretch,
    maxit = maxit
  ) %>% SlingshotDataSet
  
  # estimate pseudotime
  pseudotime <- slingPseudotime(
    curves,
    na = FALSE
  )
  rownames(pseudotime) <- Cells(seurat_obj)
  branch_id <- slingBranchID(curves)
  return(
    list(
      SlingshotDataSet = curves,
      pseudotime = pseudotime,
      branch_id = branch_id
    )
  )
}
```

### 2. Bin expression by pseudotime

Expression was aggregated within equal-width pseudotime bins independently for each lineage.

Fusiform and ray bins were subsequently aligned using a constrained monotonic DTW (Dynamic Time Warping) path.

```{r Bin expression}
bin_expression <- function(
    seurat_obj,
    pseudotime_mtx,
    lineage,
    prefix,
    n_bins
) {
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(pseudotime_mtx), Cells(seurat_obj)))
  pt <- pseudotime_mtx[, lineage]
  # Qi's labels define disjoint lineages, regardless of Slingshot branch IDs.
  keep <- as.character(seurat_obj$cell_label) %in% lineage_cell_types[[lineage]] &
    is.finite(pt)
  pt <- pt[keep]
  if (length(pt) < 2L || diff(range(pt)) <= 0) {
    stop("Insufficient pseudotime variation in ", prefix, ".")
  }
  bins <- cut(
    pt, breaks = seq(min(pt), max(pt), length.out = n_bins + 1L),
    labels = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE
  )
  names(bins) <- names(pt)
  obj <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = names(pt))
  obj$bin <- sprintf("%s-%02d", prefix, bins[Cells(obj)])
  current_assay <- DefaultAssay(obj)
  pb <- AggregateExpression(
    obj, assays = current_assay, group.by = "bin", verbose = FALSE
  )[[current_assay]]
  pb <- pb[, order(colnames(pb)), drop = FALSE]
  comp <- table(
    bin = factor(bins, levels = seq_len(n_bins)),
    cell_type = factor(as.character(seurat_obj$cell_label[keep]), levels = cluster_levels)
  )
  list(Pseudobulk = pb, Composition = comp)
}
n_bins <- as.integer(params$n_bins)
res_L1 <- bin_expression(
  seurat_obj, pseudotime, lineage = 1, n_bins = n_bins, prefix = "Fusiform"
)
res_L2 <- bin_expression(
  seurat_obj, pseudotime, lineage = 2, n_bins = n_bins, prefix = "Ray"
)
pb_L1 <- res_L1$Pseudobulk
pb_L2 <- res_L2$Pseudobulk
comp_L1 <- res_L1$Composition
comp_L2 <- res_L2$Composition

# Keep gap diagnostics in the report and workspace without changing CSV schemas.
bin_occupancy <- data.frame(
  bin = seq_len(n_bins),
  Fusiform = as.integer(rowSums(comp_L1)),
  Ray = as.integer(rowSums(comp_L2))
)
print(bin_occupancy)
missing_ray_bins <- setdiff(sprintf("Ray-%02d", seq_len(n_bins)), colnames(pb_L2))
if (length(missing_ray_bins)) {
  message("Empty ray reference bins omitted from DTW: ",
          paste(missing_ray_bins, collapse = ", "))
}
head(pb_L2)
```

Identify ray bins corresponding to the middle stage.

```{r Record bin-stage correspondance}
# read Populus marker genes
ray_mid_markers <- read.csv(params$path_ray_middle_markers)
orthogroup <- read.csv(params$path_orthogroup)

# get ortho-markers
species_marker <- get_markers(orthogroup, ray_mid_markers$gene, params$sample_id)

# get middle module
get_middle_module <- function(pb_mat, marker) {
  marker <- intersect(row.names(pb_mat), marker)
  middle_peak <- pb_mat[marker, ] %>% logcpm %>% colMeans %>% which.max
  return(
    list(
      early = 1:(middle_peak-2),
      middle = (middle_peak-1):(middle_peak+1),
      late = (middle_peak+2):ncol(pb_mat)
    )
  )
}
```

### 4. Align pseudotime bins

Find the correspondence between lineage pseudotime by the Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) algorithm:

```{r Define align_similarity_matrix}
extract_bin_id <- function(x) {
  as.integer(sub("^.*-([0-9]+)$", "\\1", x))
}
align_similarity_matrix <- function(
  similarity,
  window_size = ceiling(as.numeric(params$window_dtw) * max(dim(similarity)))
) {
  local_cost <- 1 - similarity
  fit <- dtw(
    x = local_cost,
    y = NULL,
    step.pattern = dtw::asymmetric, # Each ray bin is matched exactly once.
    window.type = "slantedband",
    window.size = window_size,
    open.begin = TRUE,
    open.end = TRUE,
    keep.internals = TRUE,
    distance.only = FALSE
  )

  path <- tibble::tibble(
    L1_i = fit$index1,
    L2_i = fit$index2,
    L1_bin = rownames(similarity)[fit$index1],
    L2_bin = colnames(similarity)[fit$index2],
    similarity = similarity[
      cbind(fit$index1, fit$index2)
    ]
  )
  list(
    fit = fit,
    path = path,
    local_cost = local_cost
  )
}
```

```{r Plot DTW path}
plot_dtw_path <- function(
  similarity,
  aligned,
  title
) {
  similarity <- as.matrix(similarity)

  stopifnot(
    max(aligned$path$L1_i) <= nrow(similarity),
    max(aligned$path$L2_i) <= ncol(similarity)
  )

  heatmap_data <- expand.grid(
    L1_i = seq_len(nrow(similarity)),
    L2_i = seq_len(ncol(similarity))

  heatmap_data$similarity <- similarity[
    cbind(
      heatmap_data$L1_i,
      heatmap_data$L2_i
    )
  ]

  ggplot(

      x = L2_i,
```

Summarize cell type correspondence along the aligned path

```{r}
composition_proportions <- function(comp, states) {
  comp <- as.matrix(comp)
  out <- matrix(
    0, nrow = nrow(comp), ncol = length(states), 
    dimnames = list(rownames(comp), states)
  )
  shared_states <- intersect(colnames(comp), states)

  out[, shared_states] <- comp[, shared_states, drop = FALSE]

  totals <- rowSums(out)

  sweep(out, 1, pmax(totals, 1), "/")
}
alignment_label_mass <- function(
    aligned,
    comp_query,
    comp_reference,
    query_states,
    reference_states
) {
  # get cell state proportion in
  query_prop <- composition_proportions(comp_query, query_states)
  reference_prop <- composition_proportions(comp_reference, reference_states)

  # get alignment path
  path <- aligned$path
  query_bin <- as.character(extract_bin_id(path$L1_bin))
  reference_bin <- as.character(extract_bin_id(path$L2_bin))

  
  mass <- matrix(
    0, nrow = length(query_states), ncol = length(reference_states),
    dimnames = list(query_state = query_states, reference_state = reference_states)
  )

  for (k in seq_len(nrow(path))) {
    mass <- mass + tcrossprod(
        query_prop[query_bin[k], , drop = TRUE],
        reference_prop[reference_bin[k], , drop = TRUE]
      )
  }

  # Equal weight for each Fusiform query pseudotime position.
  mass <- mass / nrow(path)

  stopifnot(
    isTRUE(all.equal(sum(mass), 1, tolerance = 1e-8))
  )

  mass
}
```

### 5. Calculate hourglass score

Hourglass score is defined as follows:

Let $S_i$ denote the transcriptomic similarity at aligned pseudotime position $i$, and let $\mathcal{E}$, $\mathcal{M}$, and $\mathcal{L}$ denote the sets of early-, middle-, and late-stage positions, respectively. Stage-specific mean similarities were calculated as

$$
E=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{E}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{E}}S_i,\qquad
M=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{M}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{M}}S_i,\qquad
L=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{L}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{L}}S_i.
$$

The hourglass score was then defined as

$$
H=\min\left\{M-E,\;M-L\right\}.
$$

A positive score requires the middle-stage similarity to exceed both the early- and late-stage similarities.

```{r Define function for calculating hourglass scores}
hourglass_score <- function(S, modules) {
  if (any(lengths(modules) == 0L) || any(!is.finite(S[unlist(modules)]))) {
    stop("Cannot score empty stages or non-finite aligned similarities.")
  }
  E <- mean(S[modules$early], na.rm = TRUE)
  M <- mean(S[modules$middle], na.rm = TRUE)
  L <- mean(S[modules$late], na.rm = TRUE)
  c(
    Early = E,
    Middle = M,
    Late = L,
    H = min(M - E, M - L)
  )
}
```

```{r Calculate the hourglass score}
scores_observed <- as.data.frame(t(hourglass_score(S_L1, modules))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(comparison = "Fusiform-Ray", permutation = "Observed")
scores_observed
```

### 6. Permutation test

Permute pseudotime ordering along the ray lineage, repeat the previous procedure, and estimate the null distribution of the hourglass score.

```{r Permutation test, echo=TRUE, results='hide'}
# get params
n_permutation <- as.integer(params$n_permutation)
metric <- as.character(params$metric)

# logical for subseting ray lineage pseudotime
ray_keep <- as.character(seurat_obj$cell_label) %in% ray_lineage &
  is.finite(pseudotime[, 2])
ray_pt <- pseudotime[ray_keep, 2]

# get permutation seeds
set.seed(as.integer(params$seed))
permutation_seeds <- sample.int(
  n = .Machine$integer.max,
  size = n_permutation,
  replace = FALSE
)

# register paralelle backend
n_workers_perm <- get_n_workers(
  n_tasks = n_permutation
)
message(
  "Running ", n_permutation, " permutations on ", n_workers_perm, " workers."
)
cl_perm <- parallel::makeCluster(
  n_workers_perm
)
registerDoSNOW(
  cl_perm
)

# create progress bar
perm_progress <- make_parallel_progress(
  n_permutation
)

# run permutation
scores_perm_list <- tryCatch(
  {
    foreach::foreach(
      i = seq_len(n_permutation),
      .inorder = FALSE,
      .options.snow = perm_progress$snow_options,
      .export = c(
        "lineage_cell_types", "cluster_levels", "logcpm", "calculate_js_similarity",
        "extract_bin_id", "params"
      ),
      .packages = c(
        "Seurat",
        "Matrix",
        "magrittr",
        "dtw",
        "sccore",
        "tibble"
      )
    ) %dopar% {
      
      # permute pseudotime
      pt_i <- pseudotime
      set.seed(permutation_seeds[i])
      pt_i[ray_keep, 2] <- sample(
        ray_pt,
        replace = FALSE
      )

      # Only the Ray pseudotime-to-expression association is shuffled.
      res_L2_i <- bin_expression(
        seurat_obj, pt_i, lineage = 2, n_bins = n_bins, prefix = "Ray"
      )
      pb_L2_i <- res_L2_i$Pseudobulk
      similarity_perm_i <- calculate_similarity(
        pb_L1[genes, , drop = FALSE], pb_L2_i[genes, , drop = FALSE], metrics = metric
      )
      aligned_perm_i <- align_similarity_matrix(similarity_perm_i %>% t)
      score_matrix <- t(hourglass_score(
        aligned_perm_i$path$similarity,
        modules
      ))

      # output
      data.frame(
        score_matrix,
        comparison = "Fusiform-Ray",
        permutation = sprintf(
          "Permutation-%d",
          i
        ),
        seed = permutation_seeds[i],
        row.names = NULL,
        check.names = FALSE
      )
    }
  },
  finally = {
    close(perm_progress$pb)
    parallel::stopCluster(cl_perm)
    foreach::registerDoSEQ()
  }
)

scores_perm <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  scores_perm_list
)
```

Calculate the permutation p-value

```{r Calculate the permutation p-value}
stopifnot(nrow(scores_perm) == n_permutation, all(is.finite(scores_perm$H)))
observed_H <- scores_observed %>%
  dplyr::select(
    comparison,
    H_obs = H
  )

permutation_results <- scores_perm %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(H)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    permutation,
    comparison,
    H_perm = H
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    observed_H,
    by = "comparison"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    H_obs = dplyr::first(H_obs),
    n_permutation = dplyr::n_distinct(permutation),
    n_null_ge_observed = sum(H_perm >= dplyr::first(H_obs)),
    null_mean = mean(H_perm),
    null_median = median(H_perm),
    null_sd = stats::sd(H_perm),
    null_q025 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.025)),
    null_q95 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.95)),
    null_q975 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.975)),
    observed_minus_null_mean = dplyr::first(H_obs) - mean(H_perm),
    observed_percentile = mean(H_perm < dplyr::first(H_obs)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # One-sided empirical permutation P value
    p_empirical = (n_null_ge_observed + 1) / (n_permutation + 1),
    # Adjust p-value
    p_holm = stats::p.adjust(p_empirical, method = "holm")
  )

permutation_results
```

There is only one comparison, so no two-branch joint statistic is computed. The `p_holm` column is retained for schema compatibility and equals the unadjusted P-value within this replicate.

### 7. Bootstrapping

Re-sample cells with replacement, repeat the procedure for estimating the hourglass score, and calculate the confidence interval of the hourglass score.

```{r Define bootstrapping helper functions}
# Re-sampling cells from a SeuratObject with replacement
make_bootstrap_seurat <- function(
    seurat_obj,
    seed,
    assay = DefaultAssay(seurat_obj)
) {
  set.seed(seed)

  n_cells <- ncol(seurat_obj)

  # Bootstrap draw: integer indices preserve repeated selections.
  sampled_idx <- sample.int(
    n = n_cells,
    size = n_cells,
    replace = TRUE
  )

  source_cells <- Cells(seurat_obj)[sampled_idx]

  # Extract raw counts, preserving duplicated columns.
  counts_boot <- LayerData(
    seurat_obj,
    assay = assay,
    layer = "counts"
  )[, source_cells, drop = FALSE]

  # Every bootstrap draw requires its own unique object-level ID.
  bootstrap_cells <- sprintf(
    "Boot-%05d__%s",
    seq_len(n_cells),
    source_cells
  )

  colnames(counts_boot) <- bootstrap_cells

  # Copy metadata according to the same sampled indices.
  meta_boot <- seurat_obj[[]][
    sampled_idx,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  meta_boot$source_cell <- source_cells
  meta_boot$bootstrap_draw <- seq_len(n_cells)

  rownames(meta_boot) <- bootstrap_cells

  # Let CreateSeuratObject recalculate these fields.
  qc_columns <- intersect(
    c(
      paste0("nCount_", assay),
      paste0("nFeature_", assay)
    ),
    colnames(meta_boot)
  )

  meta_boot <- meta_boot[
    ,
    setdiff(colnames(meta_boot), qc_columns),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  object_boot <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts_boot,
    assay = assay,
    meta.data = meta_boot,
    project = paste0(Project(seurat_obj), "_bootstrap")
  )

  # Preserve your published biological labels.
  if ("cell_label" %in% colnames(object_boot[[]])) {
    Idents(object_boot) <- "cell_label"
  }

  list(
    object = object_boot,
    sampled_idx = sampled_idx,
    source_cells = source_cells
  )
}

run_bootstrap_once <- function(seed) {
  on.exit(gc(), add = TRUE)
  tryCatch({
    # 1. Uniform within-replicate cell/spot bootstrap, retaining Qi's labels.
    seurat_obj_i <- make_bootstrap_seurat(seurat_obj, seed)$object
    
    # 2. Repeat preprocessing rather than freezing the original PCA/HVGs.
    seurat_obj_i <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj_i, verbose = FALSE)
    seurat_obj_i <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_obj_i, verbose = FALSE)
    seurat_obj_i <- ScaleData(
      seurat_obj_i, features = VariableFeatures(seurat_obj_i), verbose = FALSE
    )
    seurat_obj_i <- RunPCA(seurat_obj_i, npcs = 10, seed.use = 42, verbose = FALSE)
    
    # 3. Refit the two manually specified lineages.
    slingshot_res_i <- suppressWarnings(slingshot_manual(seurat_obj_i))
    
    # 4. Re-bin raw counts by the newly inferred pseudotimes.
    res_L1_i <- bin_expression(
      seurat_obj_i, slingshot_res_i$pseudotime,
      lineage = 1, n_bins = n_bins, prefix = "Fusiform"
    )
    res_L2_i <- bin_expression(
      seurat_obj_i, slingshot_res_i$pseudotime,
      lineage = 2, n_bins = n_bins, prefix = "Ray"
    )
    pb_L1_i <- res_L1_i$Pseudobulk
    pb_L2_i <- res_L2_i$Pseudobulk
    comp_L1_i <- res_L1_i$Composition
    comp_L2_i <- res_L2_i$Composition

    # 5. Re-identify middle-stage bins using the same fixed rule.
    modules_i <- get_middle_module(pb_L2_i, ray_mid_markers$gene)
    
    # 6. Use the bootstrap-specific variable genes, as in the template.
    genes_i <- intersect(rownames(pb_L1_i), rownames(pb_L2_i))
    genes_i <- intersect(genes_i, VariableFeatures(seurat_obj_i))
    if (length(genes_i) < 2L) stop("Too few variable genes remained.")
    
    # 7-8. Recalculate similarity and re-estimate the DTW alignment.
    similarity_i <- calculate_similarity(
      pb_L1_i[genes_i, , drop = FALSE], pb_L2_i[genes_i, , drop = FALSE],
      metrics = metric
    )
    aligned_i <- align_similarity_matrix(similarity_i %>% t)
    alignment_mass_i <- alignment_label_mass(
      aligned = aligned_i,
      comp_query = comp_L2_i, comp_reference = comp_L1_i,
      query_states = ray_lineage, reference_states = fusiform_lineage
    )
    
    # 9. Score the path using the FUSIFORM query bin IDs.
    scores <- data.frame(
      t(hourglass_score(
        aligned_i$path$similarity, modules_i
      )),
      comparison = "Fusiform-Ray", bootstrap = seed,
      row.names = NULL, check.names = FALSE
    )
    list(
      ok = TRUE, seed = seed, scores = scores,
      alignment_mass = list(`Fusiform-Ray` = alignment_mass_i), error = NA_character_
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    list(ok = FALSE, seed = seed, scores = NULL,
         alignment_mass = NULL, error = conditionMessage(e))
  })
}
```

Check cell type alignment

```{r}
summarize_alignment_mass <- function(
    bootstrap_output,
    bootstrap_ok,
    comparison
) {
  mass_list <- lapply(
    bootstrap_output[bootstrap_ok],
    function(x) {
      x$alignment_mass[[comparison]]
    }
  )

  if (!length(mass_list)) return(NULL)
  mass_array <- array(
    unlist(mass_list, use.names = FALSE),
    dim = c(dim(mass_list[[1L]]), length(mass_list)),
    dimnames = c(dimnames(mass_list[[1L]]), list(NULL))
  )

  list(
    mean = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), mean),
    median = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), median),
    lower = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), stats::quantile, probs = 0.025),
    upper = apply(mass_array,c(1, 2), stats::quantile, probs = 0.975),
    array = mass_array
  )
}

# No two-branch summaries: this dataset has only Fusiform-Ray.
fusiform_alignment_summary <- summarize_alignment_mass(
  bootstrap_output, bootstrap_ok, comparison = "Fusiform-Ray"
)
if (!is.null(fusiform_alignment_summary)) {
  ray_given_fusiform <- sweep(
    fusiform_alignment_summary$mean, 1,
    rowSums(fusiform_alignment_summary$mean), "/"
  )
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    ray_given_fusiform, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
    display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.2f", border_color = NA,
    main = "Fusiform-Ray bootstrap alignment\nP(Ray state | Fusiform state)"
  )
}
```

Check for failed bootstraps

```{r Check for failed bootstraps}
if (any(!bootstrap_ok)) {
  bootstrap_errors <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      bootstrap_output[!bootstrap_ok],
      function(x) {
        data.frame(
          bootstrap = x$seed,
          error = x$error,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    )
  )
} else {
  bootstrap_errors <- data.frame(
    bootstrap = integer(),
    error = character()
  )
}

message(
  sum(bootstrap_ok),
  " valid bootstrap replicates; ",
  sum(!bootstrap_ok),
  " failed replicates."
)

head(bootstrap_errors)
if (sum(bootstrap_ok) < 2L) {
  warning("Fewer than two valid bootstraps: confidence intervals will be NA.")
} else if (mean(bootstrap_ok) < 0.8) {
  warning("More than 20% of bootstraps failed; inspect bootstrap_errors before interpreting the CI.")
}
```

Calculate confidence interval

```{r Calculate confidence interval}
scores_observed_ci <- scores_observed %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    M_minus_E = Middle - Early,
    M_minus_L = Middle - Late
  )

scores_bootstrap_ci <- scores_bootstrap %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    M_minus_E = Middle - Early,
    M_minus_L = Middle - Late
  )

bootstrap_ci <- scores_bootstrap_ci %>%
  dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_bootstrap = dplyr::n_distinct(bootstrap),

    H_median = median(H, na.rm = TRUE),
    H_ci_lower = unname(quantile(H, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    H_ci_upper = unname(quantile(H, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),

    M_minus_E_median = median(M_minus_E, na.rm = TRUE),
    M_minus_E_ci_lower = unname(quantile(M_minus_E, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    M_minus_E_ci_upper = unname(quantile(M_minus_E, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),

    M_minus_L_median = median(M_minus_L, na.rm = TRUE),
    M_minus_L_ci_lower = unname(quantile(M_minus_L, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    M_minus_L_ci_upper = unname(quantile(M_minus_L, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::right_join(
    scores_observed_ci %>%
      dplyr::select(
        comparison,
        H_observed = H,
        M_minus_E_observed = M_minus_E,
        M_minus_L_observed = M_minus_L
      ),
    by = "comparison"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_bootstrap = dplyr::coalesce(n_bootstrap, 0L),
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::matches("_ci_(lower|upper)$"),
      ~ ifelse(n_bootstrap >= 2L, .x, NA_real_)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    comparison,
    H_observed,
    H_median,
    H_ci_lower,
    H_ci_upper,
    M_minus_E_observed,
    M_minus_E_ci_lower,
    M_minus_E_ci_upper,
    M_minus_L_observed,
    M_minus_L_ci_lower,
    M_minus_L_ci_upper,
    n_bootstrap
  )

bootstrap_ci
```

## Write key data

Write one long CSV containing the observed scores and the complete permutation and bootstrap distributions. The column names and order match the supplied template for `Intra-species-hourglass-bio-aggregated.Rmd`. The comparison is `Fusiform-Ray` only; there is no artificial `Joint` row. A downstream whitelist of comparison names must include `Fusiform-Ray`.

```{r Prepare key data}
observed_key <- scores_observed %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    data_type = "observed",
    replicate_id = "Observed",
    seed = NA_integer_,
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    H
  )

permutation_key <- scores_perm %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    data_type = "permutation",
    replicate_id = permutation,
    seed = as.integer(seed),
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    H
  )

bootstrap_key <- scores_bootstrap %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    data_type = "bootstrap",
    replicate_id = paste0("Bootstrap-", bootstrap),
    seed = as.integer(bootstrap),
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    H
  )

key_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  observed_key,
  permutation_key,
  bootstrap_key
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_id = sample_metadata$sample_id,
    individual_id = sample_metadata$individual_id,
    condition = sample_metadata$condition,
    batch = sample_metadata$batch,
    metric = as.character(params$metric),
    M_minus_E = Middle - Early,
    M_minus_L = Middle - Late,
    n_cells = ncol(seurat_obj),
    n_genes = length(genes),
    n_bins = n_bins,
    n_permutation = n_permutation,
    n_bootstrap_requested = n_bootstrap,
    n_bootstrap_valid = sum(bootstrap_ok),
    n_bootstrap_failed = sum(!bootstrap_ok)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    individual_id,
    condition,
    batch,
    metric,
    data_type,
    replicate_id,
    seed,
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    M_minus_E,
    M_minus_L,
    H,
    n_cells,
    n_genes,
    n_bins,
    n_permutation,
    n_bootstrap_requested,
    n_bootstrap_valid,
    n_bootstrap_failed
  )

head(key_data)
```

Write a concise sample-level summary in addition to the complete long table.

```{r Prepare key summary}
branch_key_summary <- scores_observed_ci %>%
  dplyr::select(
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    H_observed = H,
    M_minus_E_observed = M_minus_E,
    M_minus_L_observed = M_minus_L
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    permutation_results %>%
      dplyr::select(
        comparison,
        p_permutation = p_empirical,
        p_holm,
        null_mean,
        null_sd
      ),
    by = "comparison"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    bootstrap_ci %>%
      dplyr::select(
        comparison,
        H_bootstrap_median = H_median,
        H_ci_lower,
        H_ci_upper,
        n_bootstrap
      ),
    by = "comparison"
  )

key_summary <- branch_key_summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_id = sample_metadata$sample_id,
    individual_id = sample_metadata$individual_id,
    condition = sample_metadata$condition,
    batch = sample_metadata$batch,

    n_genes = length(genes),
    n_bins = n_bins,
    n_permutation = n_permutation,
    n_bootstrap_requested = n_bootstrap,
    n_bootstrap_valid = sum(bootstrap_ok),
    n_bootstrap_failed = sum(!bootstrap_ok)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    individual_id,
    condition,
    batch,
    metric,
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    M_minus_E_observed,
    M_minus_L_observed,
    H_observed,
    p_permutation,
    p_holm,
    null_mean,
    null_sd,
    H_bootstrap_median,
    H_ci_lower,
    H_ci_upper,
    n_cells,
    n_genes,
    n_bins,
    n_permutation,
    n_bootstrap_requested,
    n_bootstrap_valid,
    n_bootstrap_failed
  )

key_summary
```

```{r Write key data CSVs}
dir.create(
```
